The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. Technical Specifications Requirement: # The quoted laptop must strictly comply with the following specifications: Processor: Intel Core i3, 13th Generation or higher RAM: 8 GB or higher Storage: 512 GB SSD Display: 14-inch Full HD Operating System: Windows 11 Pro Laptop Body: Aluminum metallic body #The offered Desktop must strictly conform to the following specifications: # Processor: Intel Core i5, 12th Generation or higher # RAM: 8 GB or higher # Storage: 512 GB SSD # Monitor: 21.5" # Operating System: Windows 11 pro # Wi-Fi Connectivity The quoted model must match these specifications without deviation. 2. Warranty Requirement:

The quoted laptop must come with a clearly mentioned 3 years onsite OEM warranty. And The quoted desk top must come with a clearly mentioned 5 years onsite OEM warranty. This warranty detail must be verifia ble in the OEM’s official documentation or on the OEM’s official website. 3. OEM Specification Verification: The quoted laptop’s specifications and warranty must exactly match the bid requirements and must be ver ifiable on the OEM’s official website by the buyer at any stage of evaluation or delivery. 4. OEM-Branded Accessories Requirement: Each laptop must be supplied with one wireless mouse and one laptop bag, both of which must be original and OEM-branded to match the brand of the quoted laptop, and any offer of third-party or unbranded acce ssories will be considered non-compliant and may result in rejection of the bid or supplied goods. 5. Delivery Timeline: The entire quantity of laptops must be delivered to the consignee within 7 calendar days from the date of GeM contract generation. Any delay beyond this timeline may lead to cancellation of the order without any liability on the buyer. 6. Mandatory Product Declaration Letter: The bidder must upload a signed and stamped declaration on their official letterhead, confirming the make and model of the quoted laptop, complete technical specifications as per the bid, a firm commitment to de liver the items within 7 calendar days from the date of GeM contract generation. 7. Manufacturer Authorization Form MAF: The bidder must upload a Bid-specific Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) issued by the OEM, addressed to the consignee as per bid details, and clearly mentioning the GeM Bid Number. Bids without t he required MAF will be treated as non-compliant and rejected. 8. Compliance at Final Delivery: At the time of delivery, the supplied products must conform fully to the technical specifications, warranty t erms, and accessory requirements as per the contract. Any deviation may result in rejection of the delivery, cancellation of the order, and necessary action under GeM terms and conditions. .
